note: Art packet for an act opening. Every layer is a GPT image render against the listed references; cutout layers were rendered on pure white, processed with tools/cutout.py and encoded to WebP. Layers with a "generator" field were applied later from owner-approved candidates (see "replaced" for the art they superseded).

layers.approved: 2026-11-18 by the owner, from the story art preview
layers.prompt: Repaint this paper-theatre storybook illustration as a different place in exactly the same hand-painted paper-cutout style, cardstock texture and muted palette: a high mountain range at stormy dusk, layered torn-paper ridges of slate-blue and violet mountains, jagged grey cliffs, dark storm clouds with a rose and amber glow low on the horizon, a thin crooked mountain path climbing between the peaks, a tiny silhouette of a royal capital city with spires far away on the right horizon, calm dark rocky slope across the lower third. Remove the wheat fields, windmill and fence. No characters, no text.
layers.postprocessing: Upscaled 1248x832 -> 1536x1024 (same 3:2 aspect, Lanczos, no crop) to match the other backdrops; tools/encode.py (WebP quality 80).
